objective: N1 by hand (composites are atoms of the next level, at every depth, with unit counts), and the role of every named composite at every removed point in every class.
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (by hand, given host flat states and good leaves, both checked; pre-registered census): a knot sphere carrying good closed atoms is again good, unsatisfiable exactly where every atom inside acts, so less any point it acts as its line exactly where all its atoms act, at any depth (theorem N); a composite of genus g holds at least g - 1 units, g where it acts (lemma U). Census: the AND at all 274 removed points of seven composites; N2 as stated failed at the 102 points inside a leaf (a cut-open leaf has no role), and holds there read on the closed composite.
title: Composite atoms
